text:
Type: wooden desk with one drawer
Use: working at a laptop, writing; home office, living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, mid-century modern, Japandi
Materials: ash veneer top, solid birch legs, clear lacquer
Colors: light natural ash, pale blond wood
Shape: thin rectangular top with softly angled bevelled edges, a small drawer with a round finger hole, four round tapered splayed legs, open, slim and light
Feel: airy, warm, calm, crafted
Goes with: white walls, black or white chairs, linen, green plants; Scandinavian, Japandi or mid-century rooms
